d: Lucidya is an AI-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles autonomously, from initial engagement through retention and growth.

Unlike platforms that only surface insights and leave the action to you, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary NLU capabilities developed entirely in-house and trained on millions of multilingual conversations, equipping marketing, support, CX, and research teams to deliver personalised experiences that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, retention, and lifetime value.

We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager to own go-to-market for Lucidya's AI Unit. The AI Unit ships fast and plans in short cycles to keep pace with a rapidly changing market. This role ensures that every release is clearly positioned, well understood by our internal teams, and adopted by our customers.

You will report into the Director of Product Marketing and Customer Marketing while working day to day with the AI Unit. You will be the bridge between the team building our AI capabilities and the people who sell, support, and use them.
q: 3+ years of experience in product marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS
Experience marketing AI, machine learning, or data products
A track record of running successful product launches in a fast-moving environment
Ability to understand technical concepts and explain them simply
Comfort working across teams and managing multiple releases at once
Ability to adapt quickly as plans and priorities change
Experience in customer experience, or marketing technology
Arabic and English fluency is a must
r: Partner with the AI Unit to stay ahead of its monthly release plans and turn them into a clear launch calendar
Define launch tiers and plan the right level of go-to-market activity for each release
Lead launches end to end, from messaging and enablement to customer announcements and post-launch reporting
Develop positioning and messaging for AI capabilities that is clear, credible, and focused on customer value
Translate technical features into outcomes that resonate with Support, CX, marketing, and business leaders
Keep messaging consistent across the website, sales materials, product content, and campaigns
Build and maintain enablement materials such as pitch decks, one-pagers, demo narratives, FAQs, and battle cards
Run enablement sessions so Sales and Customer Success can confidently explain and sell new AI capabilities
Work with Customer Marketing to drive adoption of AI features among existing customers
Track the AI and Agentic CX landscape, including competitor moves and emerging trends
Gather customer and prospect feedback and share insights with the AI Unit and Product teams
Help shape priorities by bringing the voice of the market into planning discussions
Define and track success metrics for launches, including awareness, pipeline influence, and feature adoption
Report results to the Director of Product Marketing and Customer Marketing and AI Unit leadership
